provenance: Authored trajectories, not KanjiVG-derived and not a physical human handwriting corpus. Exact user screenshot coordinates unavailable.
method: Aspect-aware normalization with a thin-axis floor, banded DTW, endpoint/tangent evidence and order-independent assignment. Acceptance gates remain score < .105 and margin > .012; scores belong to different metrics and are not probabilities.
